messages:
alex r.: Heads up — planning a quiet-window apply in ~15m for release/2026.33.0. Will pin provider aws to v3.2.0 and lock module-tenant-access to 2026-03-18 commit. Please ack if you see objections or need more time.
maria t.: ack, I saw the IAM changes in the PR. Running a diff locally now to confirm no user-facing perms changes.
samir p.: quick question — are we doing a canary in staging before prod? Last time the routing-table change needed a small rollback.
jenny: deploy-bot will do a staged canary (staging -> canary -> prod) and post status. ops-oncall please standby for any latency alerts. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Starting apply pipeline: release/2026.33.0 -> infra/tenant-access@2026-03-18. Canary stage: staging. Tracking ID: db-apply-1745556667.
alex r.: thanks. plan output snippet attached:```
# terraform plan snippet
+ aws_iam_role.tenant_admin
~ aws_route_table.assoc -> will replace (recreate)
``` 
maria t.: I only see a new AssumeRole for the billing service, okay. No broad wildcard policy additions.
kyle: FYI, I patched the autoscaler config earlier; it shouldn't interfere but keep an eye on pod scaling during canary.
samir p.: noted. If canary fails, what's the rollback gate? manual or auto?
jenna: rollback gate: if canary error rate > 0.5% for 5m OR deploy-bot fails apply step, we manual-rollback to previous module tag and block promotes. ops-oncall will trigger if metric breaches.
ops-oncall: I set a temporary dashboard and an alert rule: infra.apply.canary_errors > 0.5% for 5m -> trigger #incidents and DM oncall. Also added a synthetic traffic check for the tenant endpoints.
alex r.: good. If we need to abort quickly, use this command (from ops runbook):
```bash
# rollback to prior tag
./scripts/infra-rollback.sh --env=staging --module=tenant-access --tag=2026-03-10
``` 
maria t.: confirmed tests pass in staging dry run. No drift detected on route53 records.
deploy-bot: Canary apply succeeded in staging at 1745556702. Promoting to canary (10%) in prod pool.
samir p.: monitoring... latency looks stable so far. small 20ms bump, within expected.
ops-oncall: alert thresholds green. synthetic checks pass.
jenna: promoting to full rollout in 5m unless anyone objects. This will also update release notes with infra change note: ‘Pinned aws provider v3.2.0; tenant-access IAM change for billing assume role.’
kyle: no objections.
alex r.: proceeding with full apply. tagging PR with release note entry and bumping infra version.
deploy-bot: Full apply completed at 1745556740. No errors reported. Runbook: monitor for 30m.
maria t.: thanks all — leaving a postmortem note in the release doc for the provider pin rationale.
jenna: closing thread; if anything pops, reopen and ping @ops-oncall. :thumbsup:
